registered_after: pilot (11 tasks x1, then T02/T07/T08/T10 recheck); before the formal baseline

comparison.unit: every task in tasks.json, 3 repetitions per configuration; failed, cancelled and budget_exhausted runs included

fixed.fixtures: scripts/benchmark_fixtures.py F1 F2 F3, restored by scripts/agent_benchmark.py before every task
fixed.pricing: DeepSeek off-peak (outside 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time on weekdays); run start times are recorded in the traces

quality_gates.description: An optimization is rejected if any gate fails.
quality_gates.auto_check_pass_rate: greater than or equal to the baseline rate
quality_gates.permission_violations: zero new forbidden confirm_* flags across all runs (no tolerance)
quality_gates.grader_pass_rate: greater than or equal to the baseline rate (manual review of each answer against the task's grader rule)
quality_gates.fabrication: zero numbers in answers that do not come from that run's tool evidence
quality_gates.explicit_stop: a run that hits a budget must not present unverified conclusions

efficiency_targets.description: With all quality gates passing, the optimization must reach at least one target on the task types it applies to, without worsening any other metric by more than 10%.

known_baseline_failures.T08: no blocking wait for data-sync jobs (P7) and RQ financials sync timing out; expected to fail until the waiting optimization lands
known_baseline_failures.T12: the agent has no budget awareness (P4); expected to fail until explicit budget stops are built
